    Make security the reason people trust Ockto

    Own security at the platform people use to share their most personal data

    Every day, people use Ockto to share their identity, income, assets and bank data: when they apply for a mortgage, rent a home or take out a lease. Banks and other large organisations choose Ockto partly because of the level of assurance we offer around that data. At Ockto, security is not a support function. It is part of the product and organisational culture.

    As our CISO, you make sure it stays that way as we grow. Part of that growth is adopting an AI driven operating model with strong guardrails. You own Ockto's security programme, from risk and controls to incidents, suppliers and audits. You set the standard, check that it is met, and make security measurable in a way that the whole organisation (and specifically our engineers and spec leads), clients, auditors and regulators all recognise. You do this with a real mandate and short lines to the people who decide.

    What you'll do

    You own the information security programme of a supervised financial company and make it work in daily practice, not just on paper. As CISO, you:

    • Own Ockto's ISMS and security policy framework, and keep our ISO 27001 certification (held since 2017) and our SOC 2 assurance current and credible.

    • Translate the risk appetite set by management into a security strategy, an annual plan and clear standards that teams can build to.

    • Keep Ockto ahead of what's coming. You track developments such as eIDAS2 and the EU Digital Identity Wallet, NIS2, the Cyber Resilience Act and the AI Act, assess what they mean for Ockto and our clients, and translate them into our security strategy and standards in time.

    • Verify and challenge. Our engineering teams operate the technical controls; you check that they work and that findings get fixed. You approve risk acceptance for serious vulnerabilities and commission penetration tests. All control owners are challenged and prepared to show evidence and reproduce controls.

    • Lead the response to security and privacy incidents, approve notifications to regulators, and make sure root causes lead to structural fixes.

    • Manage security risk in our supply chain, from onboarding new suppliers to the annual review of critical ones, in line with DORA.

    • Make sure our continuity and recovery arrangements are tested and hold up, together with Engineering.

    • Make security measurable. We judge it by how quickly and how structurally we resolve what we find, not by counting incidents.

    • Represent Ockto's security towards clients, auditors and supervisors: from a bank's due diligence questionnaire to our external audits and contact with DNB and AFM.

    • Build a security-aware culture with an awareness programme people actually remember.

    Who you work with

    You report to our Product & Trust Director, who sets Ockto's trust framework and risk appetite. Within that framework, the security strategy and its execution are yours. On security matters you also have a direct line to our CEO, and you are involved early in the product and architecture decisions that shape our risk. Our Information Security Officer is part of your team and runs day-to-day control monitoring with you.

    You also work closely with our Engineering Director and the value stream teams that build and run the Ockto platform. They operate the technical controls as the first line; you set the requirements, verify and challenge as the second.

    Outside Ockto, you work with the security, risk and procurement teams of our clients and with our external auditors. For audits you are the first line of planning, execution and communication with the auditor(s). Together with the Product & Trust Director, you are Ockto's security contact for DNB and AFM.


    What you bring

    You combine depth in security with the judgement to apply it pragmatically in a scale-up. We're looking for someone who:

    •     Has 8+ years of experience in information security, including at least 3 years leading a security function as CISO, Head of Security or similar.

    •     Has run an ISMS end to end and taken an organisation through ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type II audits.

    •     Knows regulated financial services and works comfortably with DORA, PSD2, GDPR and supervision by DNB or AFM.

    •     Has solid grounding in cloud security, preferably AWS, and enough technical understanding to challenge engineers and judge designs.

    •     Thinks in risk: turns threats into priorities, and weighs security against cost and delivery speed.

    •     Communicates clearly at every level, from the management team and auditors to developers and a client's security officer.

    •     Is independent and principled: comfortable saying no, and good at finding the route to yes.

    •     Speaks and writes English fluently; Dutch is a strong advantage.

    Will be a plus:

    •     CISSP, CISM, CCSP or ISO 27001 Lead Auditor or Lead Implementer certification.

    •     Experience with privacy governance and DPIAs.

    •     Experience leading incident response, including notification to regulators.

    •     Experience with third-party risk management and assurance reporting such as ISAE 3402 or ISAE 3000.

    •     Familiarity with digital identity, eIDAS2 and EU digital identity wallets.

    •     Experience governing the safe use of AI tooling in a data-sensitive environment.

    What you get

    You get a role with real influence on how far clients, supervisors and consumers can trust Ockto.

    •     Ownership of security at a company where assurance is one of the reasons clients choose us.

    •     A real mandate: a direct line to the CEO on security matters, a voice early in product and architecture decisions, and the final word on accepting serious security risk.

    •     Influence on what we build next, as Ockto grows into new markets and propositions.

    •     Short lines and room to shape the security function the way it should work.

    •     Experienced colleagues across product, engineering and compliance.

    Ockto also offers:

    •     A good salary: between €5500,- and €6800,- per month, depending on experience

    •     Room and budget for personal and professional development

    •     A MacBook Pro and smartphone of choice

    •     Phone and travel allowance

    •     Great home and remote working facilities

    •     Lunch fee

    •     Plenty of activities, including our annual ski trip, a 1.5-day team offsite, drinks and team outings

    You'll join a team that values diversity and collaboration, in a friendly, ambitious and innovative atmosphere.


    About Ockto

    Ockto is the leading platform for future-proof wallet services. For more than ten years we have been taking the friction out of sharing, verifying and enriching personal data, so that organisations and people can trust each other faster, based on the right information. From our office in Naarden, a team of specialists builds data-driven customer journeys that are right the first time.

    Ockto. Built for trust.

    Do you see yourself as our new CISO? Then apply directly. After you apply, we'll contact you within five working days to discuss the role and answer your questions.

    Want to know more first? Contact us at company culture, core values and recruitment process, or our other vacancies? Take a look at ockto.recruitee.com.

    Your data is safe

    At Ockto, we only use your CV and motivation letter during the application process to assess your application. If we don't proceed, we keep your application data for four weeks.

  • Regular use of an AI coding tool
  • Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models
  • You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words
  • At least 10 hours a week, starting now
  • A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines)

 

Nice to have

 

  • Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure
  • Experience building agent tasks or RL environments

 

Terms

 

  • US$1,000 for each task that passes our quality review, paid directly to you
  • Once your proposal is qualified, you sign Askable's contract and accept its terms
  • The work is used for AI training. The change and your solution must be your own, and you must be free to license them to us
  • Don't publish the work anywhere: no public pull request or public fork

 

Apply at https://www.askable.com/experts/roles/senior-software-engineer

About the Role

We are seeking a skilled Python / Django Developer with strong full-stack development experience and a passion for AI-assisted software development. You will build and maintain web applications, client automations, and SaaS products using Python, Django, and Claude Code.

This role goes beyond traditional software development. You will translate client requirements into clear specifications and step-by-step implementation plans, use AI coding tools to build features efficiently, and critically review, test, and refine the generated code to ensure quality and reliability.

You will work with an established application foundation and a library of reusable components, prioritising existing solutions over unnecessary redevelopment. The ideal candidate combines strong technical fundamentals with sound engineering judgement, attention to detail, and the ability to identify and correct AI-generated code that does not meet requirements.

About the Client

You will be working with an Australian software consultancy that develops business automation solutions and SaaS products. The organisation helps businesses streamline document-heavy processes involving invoices, emails, spreadsheets, and other operational workflows.

The team follows a structured, AI-assisted development approach, using established application foundations, reusable software components, and systematic testing to deliver reliable solutions efficiently. This is an opportunity to contribute to practical software products while developing expertise in AI-assisted engineering practices.

Ideal Profile

Core Development Experience

  • At least 3 years of professional full-stack development experience, including a minimum of two years working with Python and Django.
  • Strong understanding of Django fundamentals, including ORM, models, migrations, views, forms, templates, and the Django admin interface.
  • Experience working with PostgreSQL and writing accurate, efficient database queries.
  • Practical experience developing, maintaining, and debugging web applications.

AI-Assisted Development

  • Regular, hands-on use of AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar platforms.
  • Ability to review AI-generated code critically, identify errors, and make appropriate corrections.
  • Experience translating requirements into clear technical specifications and implementation plans before development.
  • A strong preference for reusable components and existing solutions rather than unnecessary custom development.
  • Willingness to use AI tools for code generation, testing, and documentation while maintaining responsibility for code quality.

Testing & Engineering Practices

  • Experience writing and maintaining automated tests, with a strong commitment to test-driven quality practices.
  • Confidence using Git, pull requests, and code reviews.
  • Ability to troubleshoot issues systematically and ensure tests pass throughout development.
  • Understanding of secure coding practices, particularly permissions, multi-tenant data, and safe file uploads.

Communication & Work Management

  • Strong written English, with the ability to prepare clear specifications, development plans, handover notes, and client updates.
  • Good organisational skills and the ability to work independently from agreed plans.
  • A commitment to honest progress reporting, timely escalation of blockers, and clear documentation.
  • A proactive approach to identifying reusable improvements and preventing recurring defects.

Desirable Experience

  • Advanced familiarity with Claude Code, including skills, plans, and subagents.
  • Experience with SaaS Pegasus or similar Django starter kits.

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Blue Origin is pioneering the future of space-based connectivity with TeraWave, a revolutionary satellite communications network designed to deliver symmetrical data speeds of up to 6 Tbps anywhere on Earth. This network will service tens of thousands of enterprise, data center, and government users who require reliable connectivity for critical operations.

As a Principal SOC Performance Analysis Engineer on the ASIC Engineering SOC Team, you will own performance analysis for a satellite communication System on Chip (SOC) supporting the TeraWave program. This is a senior individual contributor role with technical leadership scope and no direct reports. You will set the performance analysis methodology from pre-silicon modeling through emulation based verification and post-silicon validation, and your results will directly shape architectural decisions across hardware, firmware, and software teams.

L’IA fait partie de notre façon de développer

At Oceans, we believe that talent knows no boundaries. That’s why we connect the best and brightest professionals with career-defining opportunities that challenge, inspire, and accelerate their career growth. Our community, whom we call Divers, don’t just work—they dive deep, solve complex challenges, and make a real impact with global industry leaders. And in doing so, they don’t just support bold ideas—they expand their skills, broaden their expertise, and grow their careers.

As a Senior Website Implementation Specialist, you will join a growing multifamily real estate firm supporting a nationwide portfolio of residential properties. You will take hands-on technical ownership of the client’s Drupal CMS ecosystem hosted on Acquia, translating project briefs, visual assets, and content into robust, fully functioning property websites. Because the client’s web infrastructure requires customized configurations rather than simple drag-and-drop templates, you will balance custom backend coding with disciplined content management to deliver reliable digital experiences.

This is a high-ownership, execution-driven role for a disciplined technical specialist. You will become a core pillar of a nimble, high-focus web team, driving new website implementations from scratch, managing ticket queues against strict SLAs, replicating established configurations across expanding property portfolios, and ensuring rigorous quality assurance before handoff. If you excel at autonomous troubleshooting, structured file management, and leveraging modern AI workflows to accelerate backend development, this role will offer direct ownership and substantial impact.

Accountability

As a Senior Website Implementation Specialist, your success will be defined by your ability to accurately build, maintain,and expand property websites within a customized Drupal and Acquia environment while independently managing ticket queues against SLAs and maintaining flawless QA readiness.

Here’s how you’ll make an impact:

Drupal Implementation & Custom Backend Development

  • Build, configure, and maintain residential property websites within the client's Acquia-hosted Drupal architecture.
  • Implement and adapt website templates and structured CMS components using supplied briefs and creative assets.
  • Perform custom backend coding and manual configuration when native CMS functionality or standard modules are insufficient.
  • Troubleshoot technical limitations, backend blockers, and implementation bugs, ensuring strict compatibility with existing environments.
    Follow established Acquia Cloud deployment, staging, and hosting workflows while maintaining clean technical documentation.

New Website Builds, Replication & Portfolio Expansion

  • Execute end-to-end new property website implementations based on briefs provided by project management.
  • Replicate established web architectures across expanding portfolio properties, efficiently reusing templates while customizing property-specific data and content.
  • Configure components, verify asset mappings, and ensure visual and functional consistency across all portfolio sites.
  • Prepare and stage newly built and replicated sites for formal testing, ensuring all features execute seamlessly prior to launch.

Website Ticket Queue & SLA Management

  • Serve as the primary owner of the incoming website support and maintenance ticket queue.
  • Triage, prioritize, and resolve change requests, content updates, and technical adjustments in accordance with established SLAs.
  • Maintain real-time, accurate ticket statuses, track resolution deadlines, and proactively flag potential service-level delays.
  • Balance daily maintenance tickets and recurring support requests alongside active, high-priority website builds.

Quality Assurance, Testing & Asset Governance

  • Conduct thorough functional and visual testing on all website builds and updates prior to QA handoff.
  • Validate content placement, responsiveness, cross-browser performance, and template consistency to eliminate avoidable rework.
  • Address QA feedback systematically, resolving defects and verifying that all technical requirements are fulfilled.
  • Maintain rigorous file and asset organization across repositories, following strict naming conventions and directory standards to ensure zero asset misplacement.

AI-Enabled Engineering & Continuous Process Improvement

  • Incorporate AI tools (such as Claude) into daily technical workflows to investigate code, troubleshoot bugs, and accelerate repetitive implementation tasks.
  • Rigorously review, test, and validate all AI-assisted code suggestions to ensure technical integrity, security, and performance.
  • Identify recurring implementation bottlenecks and propose structured improvements to standardize builds.
  • Develop and update technical setup checklists, SOPs, and repeatable documentation to improve team efficiency as the web platform evolves.

Colleagues

You will work directly with the Website Project Manager as your primary day-to-day operational lead, while collaborating with existing website developers and cross-functional technical stakeholders during standups, testing cycles, and deployments.

At Oceans, you’ll also receive guidance and support from your Operations Manager, who will help you succeed in the role and ensure that you’re continuously growing and developing in your career.

Skills and Qualifications

At Oceans, we believe in T-shaped individuals—those who bring deep expertise in one area, paired with broad curiosity and interests. As a Senior Website Implementation Specialist, your vertical strength will be hands-on Drupal backend development and CMS implementation, while your horizontal capabilities should span ticket queue prioritization, QA discipline, AI-assisted development, and structured technical communication.

To excel in this role, you should have:

  • Experience: 4+ years of professional web development and CMS implementation experience, with dedicated,hands-on expertise building and maintaining customized Drupal websites.

Location: UK, remote, with regular overlap with US East Coast hours. Travel to customer sites in the US and Europe, to international conferences, and occasionally to London and Manchester.

About the Role

You'll own a portfolio of mostly US accounts using Biorelate's Galactic AI platform, from large pharma companies to smaller biotech teams. Your job is to make sure their researchers get measurable scientific value from Galactic Data, Web, API, MCP and Co-Scientist, and to build the evidence for renewal and expansion.
This is a hands-on role between science and technology. You'll run workshops and QBRs, and you'll also set up API access, build and test prompts and workflows, and own support for your accounts.

What We Do

Research and Development in the pharmaceutical industry is time-consuming, expensive, and often overlooks valuable data insights. We’re changing that with AI-powered data science solutions that uncover hidden insights to support more efficient and informed drug discovery. Using AI and Natural Language Processing (NLP), our technology extracts and structures data from millions of scientific documents, identifying causal biological relationships and organising them into knowledge graphs. This advanced data science empowers bioinformaticians and biologists with a deeper understanding of the connections between diseases, proteins, and drugs.

Our team consists of biomedical and data science experts with real-world lab and pharmaceutical experience. These specialists ensure that our solutions are scientifically grounded, delivering accurate, reliable data to our customers.

The Company
Biorelate is a venture backed Series A startup (supported by established Tech investors). If you’re eager to collaborate with exceptional scientists, software engineers, and subject matter experts from various fields in a supportive, ego-free environment, Biorelate is the place for you.

Key Responsibilities

What You'll Do

Adoption and Value

  • Own each account from kickoff and onboarding through to measurable scientific outcomes, with an adoption plan for each team and use case.
  • Run use case workshops that turn research problems (target identification, safety assessment, competitive intelligence, literature synthesis) into prioritised use cases.
  • Grow active and chargeable users by developing champions, reaching new teams, and getting researchers to their first real result quickly.

Renewals and Account Health

  • Own renewals and gross revenue retention (GRR), starting renewal planning at least 120 days before each renewal date.
  • Run QBRs and regular check-ins, and keep account plans and health scores current using usage data.
  • Spot declining usage early and lead the recovery plan when an account is at risk.

Technical Enablement and Support

  • Set up and troubleshoot API, MCP and Web deployments, and build prompts and example workflows around customers' own research questions.
  • Check the quality of outputs, and escalate issues to Engineering with clear reproduction details.
  • Answer security and governance questions, and route non-standard work to Forward Deployed Engineering.

Working Across Biorelate

  • Partner with the Account Manager, who owns contracting and expansion deals, by supplying adoption data, ROI evidence and expansion signals.
  • Feed customer feedback to Product, and help roll out betas, launches and training materials.
  • Support technical pre-sales conversations and represent Biorelate at conferences.

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

What You'll Bring

  • A PhD in biological or life sciences, or a related field.
  • Experience in a client-facing, post-sale role with pharma, biotech or life sciences customers, ideally in SaaS or data.
  • Familiarity with at least one of: target identification and validation, pharmacovigilance and drug safety, competitive intelligence, or literature synthesis.
  • Comfort working hands-on with APIs, LLM tools and prompt design, and the judgement to tell whether an AI-generated scientific answer holds up.
  • Confidence running workshops and training sessions with scientists and department leads.
  • A track record of moving usage numbers through structured plans, not only managing relationships.

Nice to Have

  • Experience owning renewals or GRR targets with enterprise customers.
  • Experience running QBRs with senior stakeholders.
  • Scripting experience, for example in Python.

How You'll Work

  • You own the plan for your accounts and drive it. Tasks aren't handed down.
  • You're curious about drug discovery, and happy to switch between customer meetings and focused technical work in the same day.
  • You're comfortable in a growth-stage company where processes are still being built, and keen to help build them.

Benefits

This is a rare opportunity to join Biorelate at an inflection point in our growth – and to genuinely shape how the company is seen and heard in the market. You'll work in a supportive team but you will have real autonomy to make this new role your own.
We offer competitive salaries, enhanced family leave, sick leave and significant opportunities for professional development. You’ll work alongside some of the brightest individuals, contributing to meaningful work that has a direct impact on global healthcare.
In addition, you can expect:
  • Genuine Flexibility: We are a fully remote business with colleagues across the globe: manage your schedule, save time and money on commuting, and do your best work from the comfort of your home.
  • Cutting-Edge Technology: You’ll work with the latest software tools and technologies; we’ll push you to genuinely be innovative and find new ways to solve the newest challenges.

About Veriff

Veriff is building trust infrastructure for the internet. Our AI-powered identity verification and fraud prevention platform helps businesses across fintech, crypto, gaming, mobility and marketplaces know who their users are, and whether they can be trusted, in 230+ countries and territories. We build our own technology end to end, and every verification we run teaches us something about how fraud really works.

The role

Veriff sees fraud at a scale and breadth that no single platform can see on its own. Our job now is to turn that advantage into products customers can see, measure and act on, and to build the network that makes it compound.

As Lead Product Manager for Fraud on the Veriff Network team, you will make the fraud detection, prevention and accuracy strengths of our product legible to customers. You will own the concrete product experiences that do this, such as a Feedback API that lets customers tell us what happened after a decision, fraud insights inside Station (our customer portal), and automated fraud reporting. You will also lead the customer engagement that turns those experiences into a feedback loop: customers share outcomes and signals, our detection gets sharper, and every platform on the network benefits.

This is one of the first roles on the Veriff Network, and it directly shapes how we package, sell and grow our fraud offering.

What success looks like

In your first 90 days, you will have assessed our fraud product roadmap and packaging and agreed a revised version with product and fraud leadership. You will have identified the top three to five fraud product improvements, with the highest-priority items shaped and in development.

By six months, the first updated fraud product offering is live with a group of design and beta partners.

By nine to twelve months, a shared-signal pilot is running with a set of platforms, as the first step toward a cross-platform fraud network.

By twelve months, the improved fraud products are generally available and are measurably helping us attract and close deals with our core customer segments.

What you'll bring
  • Fraud and risk expertise. You have shipped fraud or risk products, or you have been responsible for fighting fraud and managing risk at a scaled, digital-native company. You understand attack patterns, how fraud teams actually work day to day, and how the precision/recall trade-off plays out in the real world.
  • Network product experience. You have worked on network-effect or marketplace data products, where aligning incentives between participants and building feedback loops are central to the product.
  • Data and ML product craft. You can specify a signal, read a model evaluation, and ship and manage a rules engine. You know what to build yourself and what to leave to data science.
  • Customer discovery with fraud teams. You can get fraud and trust leaders at platforms talking openly, and you turn what you learn into a clear roadmap.

Nice to have

      <title>Vercel: Software Engineer - Data Platform</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote - United States
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><h2>About Vercel:</h2>
<p><span>Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company, freeing people and agents to ship what's next. For more than a decade we've helped builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience.</span></p>
<p><span>Now we're scaling our products for both agents and people to ship and run software, built in the open and trusted by OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide.</span></p></div><h2>About the Role</h2>
<p>We're looking for a Staff level Engineer to lead the design and development of a next-generation Data Platform at Vercel. This is a unique opportunity to architect a foundational system that will power data across our products and business, supporting everything from real-time analytics to AI/ML initiatives.</p>
<p>Reporting directly to the Senior Director of Data Engineering, you'll define the technical vision for our data ecosystem, work across the organization to align engineering strategy with product goals, and build scalable, reliable systems using modern technologies like Kafka, ClickHouse, Tinybird, and Snowflake.</p>
<p>You'll lead from the front, writing production-grade code, setting high standards for design and data governance, and mentoring a team of engineers as the organization grows. If you're excited by the challenge of building scalable data systems that drive product innovation, we'd love to hear from you.</p>
<h2>What You Will Do</h2>
<ul>
<li>Design and implement a next-generation data platform that supports diverse requirements, including batch and real-time integrations, advanced analytics, and multiple data types, leveraging Kafka, Kafka-based tooling, and additional streaming technologies to power real-time data movement and processing.</li>
<li>Work with engineering, product, and senior leadership teams across Vercel to architect solutions that address business needs, aligning technical strategies with product goals and ensuring seamless data availability and usability.</li>
<li>Define and maintain guidelines for data ingestion, creation, enrichment, and storage, while overseeing data modeling, ETL processes, and data warehousing (ClickHouse, Tinybird, Snowflake) to achieve low-latency analytics and scalable storage.</li>
<li>Develop end-to-end solutions across the tech stack, setting the example for engineering excellence, and provide mentorship and direction that fosters continuous improvement and innovation in the team.</li>
<li>Partner with Security, Compliance, and Legal teams to ensure adherence to data protection standards, and champion high availability and fault tolerance through comprehensive monitoring, alerting, and incident response practices.</li>
<li>Drive architectural decisions and roadmap planning that ensure efficiency, scalability, and high performance, and evaluate build-vs-buy trade-offs, integrating vendor solutions where appropriate.</li>
<li>Collaborate with data scientists and machine learning teams to evolve infrastructure that supports advanced analytics and AI initiatives, serving as a key contributor to strategy, tooling, and platform enhancements for ML-related workloads.</li>
<li>Act as a key decision-maker for discovering, vetting, and selecting data architectures and technologies critical to Vercel's success, and establish multi-phase strategic roadmaps that align with overall business objectives and drive data platform maturity.</li>
</ul>
<h2>About You</h2>
<ul>
<li>8+ years of experience in data engineering, data architecture, or related roles, with at least 5 years at the Principal Engineer level.</li>
<li>Proven track record designing and operating large-scale data infrastructures at high scale in a complex, fast-paced environment, with experience across Kafka and its ecosystem (e.g., Kafka Streams, Confluent Platform), ClickHouse, Tinybird, Snowflake, and broader big data frameworks.</li>
<li>Proficiency in cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and associated big data services.</li>
<li>Strong background in data governance and security, and adept at ensuring compliance with regulatory standards and protecting sensitive information.</li>
<li>Outstanding communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence technical and non-technical stakeholders across varying organizational levels.</li>
<li>A leadership mindset, with demonstrated ability to mentor teams, drive consensus, and advocate for best practices across the organization.</li>
<li>A Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field is preferred.</li>
<li>Industry recognition or notable contributions in data engineering (e.g., published works, open-source contributions) is a plus.</li>
</ul>
<h2>Compensation &amp; Benefits:</h2>
<ul>
<li>Competitive compensation package, including equity.</li>
<li>Inclusive Healthcare Package.</li>
<li>Learn and Grow - we provide mentorship and send you to events that help you build your network and skills.</li>
<li>Flexible Time Off.</li>
<li>We will provide you the gear you need to do your role, and a WFH budget for you to outfit your space as needed.</li>
</ul>
<p>The San Francisco, CA base pay range for this role is $232,000 - $348,000. Actual salary will be based on job-related skills, experience, and location. Compensation outside of San Francisco may be adjusted based on employee location. The total compensation package may include benefits, equity-based compensation, and eligibility for a company bonus or variable pay program depending on the role. Your recruiter can share more details during the hiring process.</p>

<li><strong>Equal Opportunity:&nbsp;</strong>Vercel is committed to fostering and empowering an inclusive community within our organization. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Vercel encourages everyone to apply for our available positions, even if they don't necessarily check every box on the job description.</li>

      <title>Maven Clinic: Client Success Manager</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> New York, NY; Remote, US (Hub cities)
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p>Maven Clinic is the world's largest virtual clinic for women and families on a mission to make healthcare work for all of us. Through Maven Enterprise, the company partners with more than 2,300 employers and health plans to provide end-to-end women's and family health programs spanning fertility and family building, maternity and newborn care, parenting and pediatrics, and menopause and midlife — improving clinical outcomes, reducing healthcare costs, and expanding equitable access to high-quality care at scale. Through its consumer platform, Maven provides direct access to virtual care across 30+ specialties, as well as dedicated hormone and GLP-1 care programs purpose-built for women. Founded in 2014 by CEO Kate Ryder, Maven Clinic has raised more than $425 million from leading healthcare and technology investors including General Catalyst, Sequoia, Dragoneer Investment Group, Oak HC/FT, StepStone Group, Icon Ventures, and Lux Capital. Recognized for innovation and industry leadership, Maven has been named to the TIME100 Most Influential Companies, CNBC Disruptor 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, and FORTUNE Best Places to Work. Learn more at mavenclinic.com</p>
<p><strong>An award-winning culture working towards an important mission –&nbsp; Maven Clinic is a recipient of over 30 workplace and innovation awards, including:&nbsp;</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>TIME 100 Most Influential Companies (2023, 2026)</li>
<li>Fortune Change the World (2024)</li>
<li>CNBC Disruptor 50 List (2022, 2023, 2024)</li>
<li>Fortune Best Workplaces for Millennials (2024)</li>
<li>Fortune Best Workplaces in Health Care (2024)</li>
<li>Fast Company Most Innovative Companies (2020, 2023)</li>
<li>Fortune Best Workplaces NY (2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024)</li>
</ul></div><p>Maven is looking for a commercially-minded and strategic Client Success Manager to join our Client Success team, to own relationships with our employer accounts.&nbsp;</p>
<p>The Client Success Manager will be the main point of contact for employer accounts introduced through Maven’s channel partnerships - driving enrollment and engagement while taking direct accountability for net revenue retention, renewal health, and expansion readiness.&nbsp; You’ll translate member outcomes into quantifiable business value for clients, orchestrate cross-functional motions with Sales, Renewals, Product, and Analytics, and build the strategic account plans that protect and grow Maven’s revenue. This is not a reactive support role,&nbsp; it’s a commercial position that requires equal parts relationship depth, analytical rigor, and business acumen. This person will be on the front lines as a trusted advisor to our clients and a key partner to our channel partnership teams.&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>As Client Success Manager at Maven, you will:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Support the success and satisfaction of your portfolio of employer clients, helping ensure strong client retention and engagement&nbsp;</li>
<li>Collaborate with channel/payer partner client executives to manage broader strategic client relationships and unlock additional business opportunities within your portfolio</li>
<li>Assist in building and maintaining account plans, tracking renewal milestones, and identifying opportunities for growth.</li>
<li>Monitor client health and engagement on an ongoing basis, flagging potential risks early and collaborating with your manager and team to develop mitigation plans.</li>
<li>Identify potential opportunities for client expansion and collaborate with Sales to build business cases and handoffs.</li>
<li>Partner with Sales and Renewals teams to ensure smooth account transitions and handoffs, contributing to clear narratives and data-supported recommendations.</li>
<li>Support client enrollment and engagement initiatives that drive measurable business outcomes, such as employee utilization, satisfaction, or program adoption.</li>
<li>Participate in Quarterly Business Reviews and other client-facing presentations, sharing data insights and supporting renewal or expansion discussions.</li>
<li>Consult clients on program optimization using Maven’s expertise, benchmark data, and program resources, ensuring measurable business impact.</li>
<li>Maintain strong client relationships, fostering satisfaction, loyalty, and advocacy, and supporting case studies or success stories where appropriate.</li>
<li>Collaborate with cross-functional teams (product, engineering, analytics, marketing) to support client projects, timelines, and deliverables.</li>
<li>Manage client inquiries, issues, and escalations, coordinating with partner teams as needed to resolve challenges.</li>
<li>Share client insights internally to help improve products, processes, and marketing initiatives.</li>
<li>Recommend improvements to client workflows or processes, supporting scalable solutions to enhance outcomes.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>What we’re looking for you to bring:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>5+ years of experience in account management, customer success, or client services within digital health, healthcare, benefits, or SaaS companies, with demonstrated ability to manage client relationships and contribute to commercial outcomes.</li>
<li>Experience working with enterprise employer clients through channel/payer partners (5,000+ employees) preferred.</li>
<li>Proven ability to support and execute marketing or engagement strategies that drive measurable client outcomes.</li>
<li>Passion for healthcare and supporting organizational change.</li>
<li>Collaborate with internal teams to deliver a seamless experience for clients, providing insights that inform product, process, or market improvements.</li>
<li>History of contributing to client retention, renewal management, and account growth opportunities.</li>
<li>Ability to build and maintain relationships with multiple stakeholders (HR, Benefits, Finance), navigating client environments effectively.</li>
<li>Experience partnering with Sales or Renewals teams to support commercial opportunities and account growth.</li>
<li>Strong interpersonal, verbal, written, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate clearly and influence internal and external stakeholders.</li>
<li>Ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks while ensuring deadlines and deliverables are met.</li>
<li>Analytical skills and strategic thinking – able to translate data and client performance into actionable insights in collaboration with clients.</li>
<li>Experience supporting the full lifecycle of customer success post-sales (implementation, adoption, product training, renewals, and account management).</li>
<li>Comfort operating in a growing and evolving environment, adaptable to changing processes and ambiguity.</li>
<li>Willingness to travel occasionally (up to 20%) for client meetings and participate in our NYC office when needed.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Helpful experiences and skills (not required, can be learned on the job):</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Experience at a digital health company in health, wellness, or family health space.</li>
<li>Experience with managing high volume of clients is preferred</li>
<li>Experience supporting health benefit programs for employer or payer clients.</li>
<li>Experience with Salesforce, Gainsight, Looker, and Microsoft Office suite.</li>
</ul>
<p>The base salary range for this role is $106,000 - 120,000 per year. You will also be entitled to receive equity and benefits. Individual pay decisions are based on qualifications, experience, and skillset.</p>
<p><strong>New York, NY; Remote, US (Hub cities)</strong>&nbsp;Maven embraces a flexible hybrid work model. Our teams primarily operate from the New York Metropolitan area, NY, San Francisco/Bay Area, CA, and&nbsp; Seattle, WA. &nbsp;For those based in NewYork, San Francisco/Bay Area, CA or Seattle, WA we encourage in-person collaboration by requiring team members to attend Work Together Days within these cities. This policy aims to balance remote work flexibility with the benefits of face-to-face interaction.<br>Remote Mavens in a commutable distance (~90 minutes driving or on public transit) to our hub cities with more than 20 employees (currently Boston, DC, Chicago, Seattle, and San Francisco) are&nbsp;<strong>expected to attend local Maven hosted Work Together Days</strong>.</p>
<p><strong>This role requires active work authorization in the US.</strong></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p class="p1">At Maven we believe that a diverse set of backgrounds and experiences enrich our teams and allow us to achieve above and beyond our goals. If you do not have experience in all of the areas detailed above, we hope that you will share your unique background with us in your application and how it can be additive to our teams.</p>
<p><strong>Benefits That Work For You</strong></p>
<p>Our benefits are designed to support your health, well-being and career development, helping you thrive both personally and professionally. We remain focused on providing a competitive benefits package for our employees. On top of standards such as employer-covered health, dental, and insurance plan options, we offer an inclusive approach to benefits:</p>
<ul>
<li>Maven for Mavens: access to the full platform and specialists, including care for mental health, reproductive health, family planning and pediatrics.</li>
<li>Whole-self care through wellness partnerships</li>
<li>Hybrid work, in office meals, and work together days&nbsp;</li>
<li>16 weeks 100% paid parental leave and new parent stipend (for Mavens who've been with us for 1 year+)</li>
<li>Annual professional development stipend and access to a personal career coach through Maven for Mavens</li>
<li>401K matching for US-based employees, with immediate vesting</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>These benefits are applicable to Maven Clinic Co., US-based, full-time employees only. 1099/Contract Providers are ineligible for these benefits.&nbsp;</strong></p>
<p>Maven is an affirmative action and equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or genetic information. Maven is committed to providing access, equal opportunity and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. Maven Clinic interview requests and job offers only originate from an @mavenclinic.com email address (e.g jsmith@mavenclinic.com). Maven Clinic will never ask for sensitive information to be delivered over email or phone. <span>If you receive a scam issue or a security issue involving Maven Clinic please notify us at: </span><a href="mailto:security@mavenclinic.com"><span>security@mavenclinic.com</span></a><span>. </span>For general and additional inquiries, please contact us at&nbsp;<a href="mailto:careers@mavenclinic.com">careers@mavenclinic.com</a>.&nbsp;</p></div>

</description>

<p>

</p>

<h2><strong>Machine Learning Engineer IV – (Computer Vision)</strong></h2>
<p>We’re looking for a Staff/Senior Machine Learning Engineer with deep expertise in computer vision and biometrics to lead the design and scaling of face recognition systems in production. You’ll build and train models, and own ML systems end-to-end on AWS. The final job level for this role will be determined following the interview process.</p>
<h3><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Lead the design and development of computer vision systems for biometrics (face attributes, detection, quality, and recognition)</li>
<li>Rigorous fairness analysis and benchmarking of biometric models across various datasets and operating conditions.</li>
<li>Architect, train, and optimize models using PyTorch, Tensorflow, and/or JAX</li>
<li>Own and evolve end-to-end ML pipelines, from data ingestion to deployment. Design automated pipelines (Airflow) for data ingestion and cleaning. You will be responsible for curating balanced training sets and generating synthetic data to address both quality and diversity gaps.</li>
<li>Production Engineering: Own the path to production. Optimize models for low-latency inference (quantization, distillation, TensorRT/ONNX) and manage deployment on AWS.</li>
<li>Mentor ML engineers, conduct code/design reviews, and drive technical best practices across the Computer Vision team.</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>What We’re Looking For</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Strong industry experience in Machine Learning, dedicated to Biometrics or Face Analysis.</li>
<li>Deep expertise in computer vision and biometrics, especially face recognition.</li>
<li>Fairness &amp; Ethics: You understand the sources of algorithmic bias in Computer Vision and have practical experience measuring and mitigating disparate impact.</li>
<li>Strong Engineering: Expert proficiency in Python (both machine learning and vision libraries such as Pillow, OpenCV, PyTorch, etc). You write clean, modular, production-ready code.</li>
<li>Systems Architecture: Experience designing end-to-end ML pipelines (Data to Train to Deploy) and working with workflow orchestrators like Airflow.</li>
<li>Cloud Native: Hands-on experience scaling training jobs on multi-GPU clusters and deploying services on AWS (SageMaker, EC2, EKS).</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>Nice to Have</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Research Publications: Papers in CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, or FG related to face recognition, image quality assessment, or fairness.</li>
<li>Large Scale Search: Experience with vector databases (e.g., Milvus, Faiss) and approximate nearest neighbor (ANN) search algorithms.</li>
<li>Familiarity with privacy, security, and compliance in biometric systems.</li>
<li>Mobile/Edge Experience: Experience porting models to edge or mobile devices utilizing frameworks such as CoreML, LiteRT, and/or TFLite.</li>
<li>Synthetic Data: Experience using GANs or diffusion models to generate synthetic faces for training.</li>
<li>Strong communication skills.</li>
</ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Jumio Values:</strong></p>
<p><span>IDEAL: Integrity, Diversity, Empowerment, Accountability, Leading Innovation </span></p>

<p><span>Jumio is a collaboration of people with different ideas, strengths, interests and cultures. We welcome applications and colleagues from all backgrounds and of all statuses.</span></p>

<p>Jumio is a B2B technology company dedicated to eradicating online identity fraud, money laundering and other financial crimes to help make the internet safer. <p>Jumio is the leading provider of online identity verification, eKYC and AML solutions. With a global footprint, we’re expanding the team to meet strong client demand across a range of industries including Financial Services, Travel, Sharing Economy, Fintech, Gaming, and others.</p>

<h2><strong>Machine Learning Engineer&nbsp;</strong></h2>
<p>We’re looking for a Machine Learning Engineer with deep expertise in computer vision and biometrics to lead the design and scaling of face recognition systems in production. You’ll build and train models, and own ML systems end-to-end on AWS. The final job level for this role will be determined following the interview process.</p>
<h3><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Lead the design and development of computer vision systems for biometrics (face attributes, detection, quality, and recognition)</li>
<li>Rigorous fairness analysis and benchmarking of biometric models across various datasets and operating conditions.</li>
<li>Architect, train, and optimize models using PyTorch, Tensorflow, and/or JAX</li>
<li>Own and evolve end-to-end ML pipelines, from data ingestion to deployment. Design automated pipelines (Airflow) for data ingestion and cleaning. You will be responsible for curating balanced training sets and generating synthetic data to address both quality and diversity gaps.</li>
<li>Production Engineering: Own the path to production. Optimize models for low-latency inference (quantization, distillation, TensorRT/ONNX) and manage deployment on AWS.</li>
<li>Mentor ML engineers, conduct code/design reviews, and drive technical best practices across the Computer Vision team.</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>What We’re Looking For</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Experience: Multiple years of industry experience in Machine Learning, with at least 3 years dedicated to Biometrics or Face Analysis.</li>
<li>Deep expertise in computer vision and biometrics, especially face recognition.</li>
<li>Fairness &amp; Ethics: You understand the sources of algorithmic bias in Computer Vision and have practical experience measuring and mitigating disparate impact.</li>
<li>Strong Engineering: Expert proficiency in Python (both machine learning and vision libraries such as Pillow, OpenCV, PyTorch, etc). You write clean, modular, production-ready code.</li>
<li>Systems Architecture: Experience designing end-to-end ML pipelines (Data to Train to Deploy) and working with workflow orchestrators like Airflow.</li>
<li>Cloud Native: Hands-on experience scaling training jobs on multi-GPU clusters and deploying services on AWS (SageMaker, EC2, EKS).</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>Nice to Have</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Research Publications: Papers in CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, or FG related to face recognition, image quality assessment, or fairness.</li>
<li>Large Scale Search: Experience with vector databases (e.g., Milvus, Faiss) and approximate nearest neighbor (ANN) search algorithms.</li>
<li>Familiarity with privacy, security, and compliance in biometric systems.</li>
<li>Mobile/Edge Experience: Experience porting models to edge or mobile devices utilizing frameworks such as CoreML, LiteRT, and/or TFLite.</li>
<li>Synthetic Data: Experience using GANs or diffusion models to generate synthetic faces for training.</li>
<li>Strong communication skills.</li>
</ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Jumio Values:</strong></p>
<p><span>IDEAL: Integrity, Diversity, Empowerment, Accountability, Leading Innovation </span></p>
<p><strong>Equal Opportunities</strong><span><strong>: </strong></span></p>
<p><span>Jumio is a collaboration of people with different ideas, strengths, interests and cultures. We welcome applications and colleagues from all backgrounds and of all statuses.</span></p>
<p><strong>About Jumio:</strong></p>
<p>Jumio is a B2B technology company dedicated to eradicating online identity fraud, money laundering and other financial crimes to help make the internet safer. We leverage AI, biometrics, machine learning, liveness detection and automation to create solutions that are trusted by leading brands worldwide and respected by industry thought leaders.&nbsp;</p>
<p>Jumio is the leading provider of online identity verification, eKYC and AML solutions. With a global footprint, we’re expanding the team to meet strong client demand across a range of industries including Financial Services, Travel, Sharing Economy, Fintech, Gaming, and others.</p>

      <title>Abnormal: Director of Security Engineering</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote - USA
</p>

<h2>About the Role</h2>
<p>Abnormal AI protects organizations from the most sophisticated email and collaboration attacks using behavioral AI. Security is not a bolt-on at Abnormal; it is core to the product we sell and the trust our customers place in us. Our security organization operates a commercial cloud environment and a separate FedRAMP-authorized environment, and we are pursuing increasingly rigorous federal authorizations as we grow.</p>
<p>We are hiring a Director of Security reporting to the CISO and leading the Security Engineering organization. You will build and scale high-performing security teams, own major security programs end to end, and operate autonomously in the CISO's absence, including representing security to executive leadership, customers, and auditors.</p>
<p>This is a role for a deeply technical leader with a software engineering background who has grown into people leadership. You have built security teams from the ground up, you write and review code and architecture when it matters, and you believe the best security organizations earn their influence through partnership rather than policy enforcement.</p>
<h2>Our Security Philosophy</h2>
<p>We run security the way the best engineering-led companies do:</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Security reduces toil.</strong> Our job is to make the rest of the company faster and safer at the same time. If a control adds friction without reducing risk, it is a defect.</li>
<li><strong>Paved paths, safe by default.</strong> We invest in guardrails, golden paths, and secure-by-default infrastructure so the easy choice is the secure choice. We prefer preventing classes of problems over chasing individual findings.</li>
<li><strong>Partnership over gatekeeping.</strong> Security succeeds only through deep collaboration with engineering, IT, and business teams. We embed with builders, we ship alongside them, and we take on their constraints as our own.</li>
<li><strong>Engineering-grade rigor.</strong> We treat security problems as engineering problems: automated, measurable, code-reviewed, and continuously improved.</li>
</ul>
<p>If the security cultures that value freedom and responsibility, context over control, and guardrails over gates resonate with you, you will feel at home here.</p>
<h2>What You Will Do</h2>
<ul>
<li>Serve as deputy to the CISO: act with full authority in the CISO's absence and represent the security organization to executives, customers, and regulators.</li>
<li>Lead, coach, and grow managers and senior engineers across Security Engineering and Security Operations.</li>
<li>Own the security engineering roadmap: cloud security architecture (AWS-first), detection and response, identity, vulnerability management, and secure-by-default platform investments.</li>
<li>Drive cross-functional programs with Engineering, IT, and Product, from AI security governance to data perimeter controls to federal compliance initiatives.</li>
<li>Set and defend engineering standards for the security organization: everything as code, automated where possible, measured against outcomes rather than activity.</li>
<li>Build hiring pipelines and raise the bar on every hire; own performance management, promotion cases, and succession planning within your teams.</li>
<li>Translate technical risk into business terms for the executive team and board, and translate business priorities into a coherent security strategy.</li>
</ul>
<h2>Must Haves</h2>
<ul>
<li>10+ years in security or software engineering, including 4+ years managing security teams, ideally including managers of managers or equivalent scope.</li>
<li>A genuine software engineering background: you have shipped production software, and you evaluate security solutions the way an engineer would.</li>
<li>A proven record of building and scaling high-performing security teams, with alumni who would work for you again.</li>
<li>Deep technical fluency in cloud-native environments: AWS organizations and multi-account governance, Kubernetes, identity and access, detection engineering, and modern SDLC security.</li>
<li>Demonstrated cross-functional leadership: you have earned the trust of engineering leaders and shipped security outcomes through their teams, not around them.</li>
<li>Strong written communication: you produce decision-ready documents and can drive alignment asynchronously.</li>
<li>Executive presence: comfortable presenting to C-level leadership, customers, and auditors without preparation from the CISO.</li>
</ul>
<h2>Strong Signals</h2>
<ul>
<li>You are currently a security engineering manager or senior manager at a fintech, high-growth startup, or forward-leaning enterprise, and you are ready for broader scope.</li>
<li>You have built paved-path or secure-by-default platforms that measurably reduced both risk and developer friction.</li>
<li>Experience with compliance-driven environments (FedRAMP, SOC 2, ISO 27001) without letting compliance define the security program.</li>
<li>Experience securing AI/ML systems or governing AI adoption at scale.</li>
<li>You have operated in environments where security headcount was scarce and automation was the only way to scale.</li>
</ul>
<h2>Why This Role</h2>
<p>You will inherit strong teams, an executive staff that treats security as a first-class function, and a CISO who wants a true partner rather than a lieutenant. The scope is broad, the autonomy is real, and the ceiling on this role is defined by what you take on.</p>
<p>#LI-ML1</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p>Actual compensation will be determined based on several non-discriminatory factors including skills, experience, qualifications, and geographic location.<br>In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for bonus or incentive compensation, equity, and a comprehensive benefits package.</p></div><div class="title">Base salary range:</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$214,200</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>$308,000 USD</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>A note on AI in our process:&nbsp;<br></strong>Abnormal AI uses AI-assisted tools to help our recruiting team prepare for candidate interviews. These tools analyze resume content and role requirements to suggest interview questions and areas for the interviewer to explore.They do not make hiring decisions or screen candidates automatically. Every decision about a candidacy is made by a person. Further, if your application is successful and Abnormal AI makes a conditional offer of employment, we will carry out pre-employment checks which must be successfully completed to progress to a final offer. All processes and pre-employment checks are in line with prevailing legislation and Abnormal AI's policies relevant to our security and privacy standards.</p>
<p>Abnormal AI is an equal opportunity employer. <p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Portugal - Remote
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>Be Part of Building the Future</strong></h2>
<p>Dremio is the unified lakehouse platform for self-service analytics and AI, serving hundreds of global enterprises, including Maersk, Amazon, Regeneron, NetApp, and S&amp;P Global. Customers rely on Dremio for cloud, hybrid, and on-prem lakehouses to power their data mesh, data warehouse migration, data virtualization, and unified data access use cases. Based on open source technologies, including Apache Iceberg and Apache Arrow, Dremio provides an open lakehouse architecture enabling the fastest time to insight and platform flexibility at a fraction of the cost.&nbsp; Learn more at&nbsp;<a class="c-link" href="http://www.dremio.com/">www.dremio.com.</a></p></div><p><strong>About the role</strong><br>Dremio’s Query Execution team builds the runtime responsible for executing analytical queries at scale. The team sits between query planning and table scans, building the systems that turn query plans into efficient, reliable execution.</p>
<p>As a Software Engineer, you’ll work with experienced engineers to build, test, and support well-scoped improvements to the execution engine. You’ll learn how Dremio’s query runtime works while contributing to areas such as query operators, expression evaluation, memory management, scheduling, and performance.<br><br><strong>What you’ll be doing</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Build and support execution-engine components: Implement, test, debug, and maintain well-defined changes to query operators, expression evaluation, execution scheduling, and resource management.</li>
<li>Develop reliable software: Write clear, maintainable Java code; add unit and integration tests; and follow established engineering practices for code review, testing, and documentation.</li>
<li>Investigate issues: Help diagnose query correctness, reliability, and performance issues using query profiles, logs, telemetry, benchmarks, and production data.</li>
<li>Learn runtime and performance fundamentals: Build familiarity with vectorized processing, concurrency, memory usage, parallelism, data exchange, and disk spilling.</li>
<li>Collaborate with the team: Work closely with senior engineers and partner teams to understand requirements, break work into manageable tasks, and deliver incremental improvements.</li>
<li>Use AI-assisted development tools: Apply AI tools to code comprehension, debugging, test generation, and documentation, while validating results through testing, review, and sound engineering judgment.</li>
<li>Grow your engineering skills: Participate actively in design discussions and code reviews, seek feedback, and steadily take on broader technical responsibility.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>What we’re looking for</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Software engineering foundation: Up to two years of professional software development experience, or equivalent experience through internships, coursework, or substantial personal projects.</li>
<li>Programming skills: Proficiency in Java or another object-oriented programming language; willingness to learn and work in a large Java codebase.</li>
<li>Computer science fundamentals: Understanding of data structures, algorithms, and basic concurrency concepts.</li>
<li>Problem-solving ability: Able to work through well-defined technical problems, ask good questions, and apply feedback to reach a solution.</li>
<li>Quality mindset: Commitment to writing tested, maintainable code and learning established development, testing, and review practices.</li>
<li>Communication and collaboration: Able to communicate progress, surface blockers early, and work effectively with teammates.</li>
<li>Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Bonus points if you have</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<ul>
<li>Exposure to database internals, query processing, distributed systems, or large-scale data processing.</li>
<li>Familiarity with performance-oriented software concepts such as profiling, memory management, concurrency, or vectorized processing.</li>
<li>Experience with C++, Apache Arrow, Parquet, Apache Iceberg, Spark, Hadoop, or cloud object stores.</li>
<li>Contributions to open-source projects.</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3><strong>What we value&nbsp;</strong></h3>
<p><span>At Dremio, we hold ourselves to high standards when it comes to People, Thinking, and Action. Our Gnarlies (that's what we call our employees) communicate with clarity, drive accountability, and are respectful towards each other. We confront brutal facts and focus on results while operating with a sense of urgency and building a "flywheel". People who like to jump in and drive momentum will thrive in our #GnarlyLife.</span></p>
<p><em><span>Dremio is an equal opportunity employer supporting workforce diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other unlawful factor.</span></em></p>
<p><em><span>Dremio is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.</span></em></p>
<p><em><span>Dremio has policies in place to protect the personal information that employees and applicants disclose to us. Please click </span></em><a href="https://docs.google.com/document/d/1CB96QFmOX-bFy48YFOe2GO5lmdawOpKKBj8DpTgsuNg/edit?usp=sharing"><em><span>here</span></em></a><em><span> to review the privacy notice.&nbsp;</span></em></p>
<h3><strong>Important Security Notice for Candidates</strong></h3>
<p><span>At Dremio, we uphold trust and transparency as paramount values in all our interactions with customers, partners, employees, and the general public. We have been targeted by individuals creating fake domains similar to ours to scam prospects and candidates. Please note that all official communications from us will be from an @dremio.com domain. If you suspect you've been targeted by a scam, it's imperative to report the incident to your local law enforcement agencies. For more information about this type of scam, please refer to Dremio's official statement&nbsp;<a href="https://www.dremio.com/blog/stay-alert-for-fraudulent-recruitment-attempts-that-falsely-claim-association-with-dremio/">here</a>.</span></p>
<p><em>Dremio is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company that does not have a signed agreement with the Company.</em></p></div>

<div class="content-intro"><p>PagerDuty, Inc. (NYSE: PD) is the global leader in AI-first digital operations.
